text.offer: Yes, perhaps you'll do. Prove your loyalty by murdering one of the rebels. You can usually find some guarding a flagpole. Come back afterwards to tell of your deeds.
text.progress: Duke Akardius will allow you to join the Ducal army, but first you must prove your loyalty by slaying his enemies at the flagpoles.
text.complete: You have done well, my soldier. Join the ranks of the elite and bring my influence and power to those in this land!

steps.brief: Excellent. Now, show your contempt for my enemies by murdering one of the Princess's soldiers. Return to me when you are done to let me know the deed is done.
